title: Shortsword
summary: 1d6 Piercing shortsword with native BG3 weapon actions.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 Piercing plus Dexterity or Strength. Martial, one-handed, finesse, light, 5 ft. The weapon’s enchantment also applies to attack rolls.
fields.Flourish: Bonus Action, with proficiency, once per Short Rest. Melee attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. Dexterity save prevents Off Balance for 2 turns. The linked base save row lists weapon-action DC and the effect row lists weapon-action DC +2. Off Balance gives disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and advantage to attackers. Taking damage or Help ends it.
fields.Piercing Strike: Action, with proficiency, once per Short Rest. Melee weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. Healing ends it. Successful attacks add 2 Piercing in standard modes. In Honour, any damage source adds 2 of its own type.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
